newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Syria's Khaddam and Shara arrive in UAE.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Khaddam and Shara arrive in UAE.

text.p: Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara arrived in the United Arab Emirates' capital Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, the official WAM news agency said.
The small oil-producing state is the third stop on the Syrian officials' Gulf tour. They had previously made brief visits to Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.
The agency said Khaddam and Shara would stay in the UAE for two days, but gave no further details of their visit.
